pass_rule: Polarity-SASRec NDCG@10 is higher than popularity
latency_note: p95@20 from the Vanilla-SASRec HTTP benchmark; Veto uses the same forward pass. Polarity-SASRec is the same latency class (not separately timed on this page).

popularity.label: Popularity
popularity.behavior: Same ranking for every viewer; history only masks seen films

item_knn.label: Item-to-item
item_knn.behavior: Shared audience with liked films; order ignored

vanilla.label: Vanilla-SASRec
vanilla.behavior: Ordered like ids only; full-catalog next-item scores

veto.label: Veto-SASRec
veto.behavior: Proposed Enhanced add-on: post-score mask of ≤3★ titles (score → −∞); no retrain

signed_trail.label: Polarity-SASRec
signed_trail.behavior: Proposed Enhanced: like/dislike polarity embeddings; next-like; optional Veto mask at serve
signed_trail.p95_note: same class as Vanilla (not separately timed)
